schemaVersion: Ehel Stage 4 Art & Design Placement Exam v1.0
subject: Art & Design
title: Stage 4 Art & Design Starting Check
description: A short, friendly check of what you learned in Grade 3 - sketchbooks, tone and the colour wheel, clay reliefs, textiles and murals, artists and portfolios - so we know where to start and which Grade 3 lessons to look at again.
attemptsAllowed: Unlimited - this check finds your starting point; it is never a fail
feedbackMode: Immediate child-friendly feedback with a starting-point report
_comment: Grade 3's content, asked the Grade 3 way: `pic` and `optionPics` are optional pictures for a young reader (an emoji, `mark:<kind>` for a line drawn by the lesson kit, or `swatch:<hex>`). Review lessons are Grade 3's, and the page links them in ../grade-3-v2/. Built into starting-check.html by ../lesson-kit/build-check.py and checked by ../lesson-kit/check-coverage.py.

ready.label: Ready for Stage 4
ready.message: Brilliant! You remember your sketchbook, your tone, your colour wheel and your clay. Start with Lesson 1 and enjoy Grade 4.
